perpetual_langtons_ant — GENERATIVE perpetual op

• Data kinds: none → rgb (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.perpetual_langtons_ant(steps: 'int' = 12000, size: 'int' = 301) -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import perpetual; perpetual.perpetual_langtons_ant(steps: 'int' = 12000, size: 'int' = 301) -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsgenerative.get("perpetual_langtons_ant"))

Usage

Langton's ant — with just 2 rules, after 10,000 steps it keeps building a "highway".

Invariant: once on the highway, it advances diagonally by (-2,-2) with period 104.

★The shading is "the time that cell spent black". The highway forms last, so it is light, and the initial chaos is dark -- the order of time shows in the picture.
